entries.title: Route simple and complex work to the configured models
Produce approved Markdown and HTML design artifacts
Features, tasks, and Gherkin files with fresh RECORD_DECOMPOSITION_APPROVAL gate
Placeholder-free plans with fresh RECORD_PLAN_APPROVAL gate
Distinguish parallel-safe work from dependent or conflicting work
Detect and recover stuck agents, resume by generated session ID, replace without duplicate writes
Keep operational state outside candidate content in Git and non-Git workspaces
Stop non-Git work after planning; require validated complete Git repository for retained implementation
Route technical failures through systematic debugging
Update documentation from implemented repository state
Refuse commit without exact authorization tuple; COMMIT with per-call manifests and pre-ref-mutation OID equality
Invoke the Python review skill whenever Python changes are reviewed
Refuse adversarial review until standard review passes
Never execute a push; present the bound non-force command only after both reviews and explicit user request
